docs.title: Central Bank of Valdora holds policy rate
docs.body: The Central Bank of Valdora held its policy rate at 4.25 percent on Thursday, pausing after 18 months of tightening. Three of the nine board members voted for a 25 basis point cut. The bank lowered its 2026 growth forecast to 1.4 percent from 2.1 percent, citing softer external demand.

docs.title: Northwind Semiconductor cuts full-year outlook
docs.body: Northwind Semiconductor reported quarterly revenue of 890 million credits, up 12 percent year over year but short of the 920 million analysts expected. The company cut its full-year outlook, citing weaker demand from data-center customers. Shares fell 7.5 percent in after-hours trading.

docs.title: Meridian Strait suspensions lift container rates
docs.body: Container rates on the Meridian Strait route rose 64 percent this month after two carriers suspended transits. Average transit times have lengthened by 9 days. Analysts at Harbourline estimate the disruption adds 0.3 percentage points to goods inflation if sustained through the quarter.

docs.title: Crude eases as Valdora Basin pipeline restarts
docs.body: Benchmark crude settled at 71 credits a barrel, down 2.7 percent on the week, as the Valdora Basin pipeline resumed operation ahead of schedule. Natural gas storage sits 11 percent above the seasonal average.

docs.title: Valdoran payrolls beat consensus in June
docs.body: Valdoran payrolls grew by 310 thousand in June, well above the 240 thousand consensus. The unemployment rate held at 3.1 percent. Average hourly earnings rose 0.2 percent on the month, a pace consistent with gradually cooling wage pressure.
